headline: Nigerian Smartphone Market Contracts 44% as Inflation Squeezes Consumers
summary: Smartphone shipments to Nigeria dropped 44% as elevated living costs reduced consumer spending power. Analysts project shipments will experience a further 25% contraction by 2027.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest mobile communications market by subscriber volume.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Smartphone sales in Nigeria plummeted 44% due to severe cost-of-living pressures.
